verdict.rationale: Viam's docs say data queues locally during network outages and low-bandwidth periods, syncs when connectivity returns, and handles restarts and storage constraints automatically. An independent community account adds that robots keep running offline, with configs cached locally so even a reboot without internet works, and that robots can talk to each other with no outside communication. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on buffer limits and sync/recovery behavior (the claim comes only from a marketing overview), and how long offline operation lasts beyond the reported TLS cert expiry (~30+ days).
